BatchUpdateNoticeStatus.description_en: Updates the notification status in batches

CancelCertificateForPackageRequest.description_en: Revokes an issued certificate or cancels a pending certificate order and restores the quota
CancelCertificateForPackageRequest.description_zh: 如果是已签发订单，则吊销已签发的证书；如果是待申请订单，则取消订单，返回额度

CancelOrderRequest.description_en: Cancels a certificate application order that is pending domain verification or under review
CancelOrderRequest.description_zh: 撤回待验证、审核中的证书申请订单

CreateCertificateForPackageRequest.description_en: Submits a certificate application by using a purchased certificate package quota

CreateCertificateRequest.description_en: Purchases, applies for, and issues a domain validated (DV) certificate by using extended certificate services
CreateCertificateRequest.description_zh: 完成扩展服务DV证书的购买、申请和签发流程

CreateCertificateWithCsrRequest.description_en: Purchases, applies for, and issues a domain validated (DV) certificate by using a custom certificate signing request (CSR) file
CreateCertificateWithCsrRequest.description_zh: 购买、申请和签发自带CSR文件的DV证书。证书扩展服务可通过一步完成DV证书的购买和申请

CreateCsr.description_en: Creates a certificate signing request (CSR) that contains information about an SSL certificate to apply for, such as the domain names and the certificate holder. You must provide a CSR when you submit a certificate application to a certificate authority (CA)
CreateCsr.description_zh: CSR是证书请求文件，包含您的SSL证书信息，例如，证书绑定的域名、证书持有主体的名称及地理位置信息等。您向CA中心提交证书申请时，必须提供CSR。CA中心审核通过您的证书申请后，将使用其根CA私钥为您提供的CSR签名，生成SSL证书公钥（即签发给您的SSL证书）。SSL证书的私钥即您在生成CSR时同时生成的私钥

CreateDeploymentJob.description_en: Creates a certificate deployment task to deploy an SSL certificate to one or more Alibaba Cloud services immediately or at a scheduled time
CreateDeploymentJob.description_zh: SSL证书签发完成后，您可以通过该接口创建不同类型的证书部署任务，立即或手动指定任务部署时间，将SSL证书部署到阿里云产品或三方云产品，为您的业务网站提供可信身份认证和安全数据传输

CreateWHClientCertificate.description_en: Issues a single client certificate from the general user certificate repository
CreateWHClientCertificate.description_zh: 一般用户证书仓库中，申请签发单个客户端证书

Decrypt.description_en: Decrypts data that was encrypted by using a certificate in a certificate application repository
Decrypt.description_zh: 本接口一般用于证书仓库中证书解密

DeleteCertificateRequest.description_en: Deletes a failed domain validated (DV) certificate application order
DeleteCertificateRequest.description_zh: 删除DV证书申请失败的订单

DeleteCsr.description_zh: 如果您不再需要某个CSR，可以将其删除

DeletePCACert.description_en: Deletes a private certificate from a certificate application repository
DeletePCACert.description_zh: 本接口一般用于删除证书仓库中PCA证书

DeleteUserCertificate.description_en: Deletes an expired, revoked, or uploaded certificate
DeleteUserCertificate.description_zh: 删除已过期、已吊销或上传的证书

DeleteWorkerResource.description_en: Deletes a worker task from a certificate deployment task

DescribeCertificateState.description_en: Queries the status of a certificate application order, such as domain validation progress
DescribeCertificateState.description_zh: 查询指定的证书申请订单的状态

DescribeCloudResourceStatus.description_en: Queries the number of cloud resources on which certificates were deployed by using a multi-cloud deployment task
DescribeCloudResourceStatus.description_zh: 您可通过本接口获取通过多云部署任务，部署证书到三方云产品的资源数

DescribeDeploymentJob.description_en: Retrieves information about a certificate deployment task, including the task status, target resources, and certificates
DescribeDeploymentJob.description_zh: 通过CreateDeploymentJob创建部署任务后会获取任务ID，您可以通过该任务ID调用本接口获取部署任务详情

DescribeDeploymentJobStatus.description_en: Queries the execution status summary of a certificate deployment task, including the number of succeeded and failed workers
DescribeDeploymentJobStatus.description_zh: 获取部署任务下的Worker任务数

DescribePackageState.description_en: Queries the quota and usage of domain validated (DV) certificate packages
DescribePackageState.description_zh: 查询已经购买的DV证书总数和使用情况

DescribeWarehouseCert.description_en: Retrieves the details of a certificate stored in a certificate warehouse

Encrypt.description_en: Encrypts data by using a certificate in a certificate application repository
Encrypt.description_zh: 本接口一般用于证书仓库中证书加密

GetCertWarehouseQuota.description_en: Queries the remaining quota for certificate application repository operations
GetCertWarehouseQuota.description_zh: 调用证书应用仓库签名、验签、加密和解密API时，会消耗API调用次数，API调用次数消耗完时，您将无法再调用相应的API。本接口一般用于查询证书仓库额度

GetCertificateDetail.description_en: Queries the details of a certificate without returning the certificate content or private key content
GetCertificateDetail.description_zh: 查询证书详情，不返回证书内容和私钥内容

GetCertificatePackageCount.description_en: Retrieves the number of certificate resource plans

GetCompany.description_en: Retrieves the details of a company

GetCsrDetail.description_en: Queries the content of a certificate signing request (CSR)
GetCsrDetail.description_zh: 通过CreateCsr接口创建CSR后会返回CsrId，您可以通过CsrId直接获取CSR内容

GetInstanceDetail.description_en: Queries the details of an instance

GetInstanceSummary.description_en: Queries the summary statistics of Certificate Management Service instances, such as certificate counts by status

GetMatchedResources.description_en: Retrieves the resources that match a certificate

GetRiskCount.description_en: Queries the number of assets with certificate-related risks, such as expired or soon-to-expire certificates

GetTaskAttribute.description_en: Queries the processing result and status of a submitted certificate application
GetTaskAttribute.description_zh: 申请证书提交结果查询

GetUserCertificateDetail.description_en: Retrieves the details of a certificate, including basic information and public/private key content. You can use this operation to download the certificate content and private key
GetUserCertificateDetail.description_zh: 本接口一般用于获取证书详情，包含基本信息和公私钥内容。可以通过该接口下载证书内容和私钥

ListAssetCount.description_en: Queries the resource statistics list of cloud services
ListAssetCount.description_zh: 查询云产品资源统计列表

ListCert.description_en: This API queries certificates in the certificate store
ListCert.description_zh: 本接口一般用于查询证书仓库中的证书

ListCertWarehouse.description_en: Queries the list of certificate repositories
ListCertWarehouse.description_zh: 本接口一般用于查询证书仓库列表

ListCertificates.description_en: Queries the certificates managed by Certificate Management Service

ListCloudAccess.description_en: Queries the AccessKey pairs that are configured for multi-cloud certificate deployment

ListCloudResources.description_en: Queries the cloud resources on which certificates are deployed, such as Server Load Balancer (SLB) instances and CDN domains
ListCloudResources.description_zh: 您可以通过本接口获取云厂商及对应云产品的资源列表

ListCsr.description_en: Queries the certificate signing requests (CSRs) in your account
ListCsr.description_zh: 查询CSR列表信息及CSR详细信息

ListDeploymentJob.description_en: Retrieves a list of deployment tasks after you create a deployment task
ListDeploymentJob.description_zh: 创建部署任务后，您可以通过该接口获取部署任务列表

ListDeploymentJobCert.description_en: Queries the certificates associated with a deployment task, such as the certificate instance ID, type, and name
ListDeploymentJobCert.description_zh: 创建部署任务后，可通过本接口获取部署到云产品的证书基本信息，例如证书实例ID、证书类型、证书名称等

ListDeploymentJobResource.description_en: Queries the cloud resources associated with a deployment task. An empty list indicates that the resources are invalid and must be re-associated
ListDeploymentJobResource.description_zh: 任务在未完成执行状态时，获取部署任务关联的云产品资源列表。返回空列表表示关联的资源列表已经失效，需要重新关联。任务已经完成状态，资源发生变化时该列表返回空

ListTagKeys.description_en: Retrieves a list of tag keys and values

ListTagResources.description_en: Retrieves the tags associated with a resource

ListTrusteeOrder.description_en: Retrieves the list of managed orders

ListUserCertificateOrder.description_en: Queries the list of user certificates or orders
ListUserCertificateOrder.description_zh: 查询用户证书或者订单列表

ListWorkerResource.description_en: Queries the worker tasks of a deployment task. Each worker task deploys a certificate to a specific cloud resource in a cloud service
ListWorkerResource.description_zh: 阿里云支持批量部署证书，因此一个部署任务中可能对应多个云产品子任务（Worker），对应每个产品中的资源实例，您可通过该接口查看Worker任务详细信息

MoveResourceGroup.description_en: Changes the resource group to which a certificate or certificate order belongs
MoveResourceGroup.description_zh: 修改证书或证书订单资源所属的资源组

RenewCertificateOrderForPackageRequest.description_en: Submits a renewal application for an issued SSL certificate
RenewCertificateOrderForPackageRequest.description_zh: 为已签发的证书申请订单续费

RevokeWHClientCertificate.description_en: Revokes a client certificate from the certificate repository
RevokeWHClientCertificate.description_zh: 一般用于吊销证书仓库中客户端证书

Sign.description_en: This operation creates a digital signature with a PCA certificate from a certificate repository
Sign.description_zh: 本接口一般用于证书仓库中的PCA证书签名

UpdateCsr.description_en: Uploads the private key corresponding to a CSR if you did not provide the CSR private key when uploading the local CSR
UpdateCsr.description_zh: 如果您在上传本地CSR时未传入CSR私钥，您可以通过该接口上传CSR对应的私钥

UpdateDeploymentJob.description_en: Updates the configuration of a certificate deployment task, such as the certificates or target resources

UpdateDeploymentJobStatus.description_en: Updates the status of a certificate deployment task, such as changing from editing to pending execution

UpdateWorkerResourceStatus.description_en: Updates the status of a worker task in a deployment task
UpdateWorkerResourceStatus.description_zh: 更新部署任务下的Worker任务状态

UploadCsr.description_en: Uploads an existing certificate signing request (CSR) to Certificate Management Service. After the upload, you can use the CSR to apply for certificates
UploadCsr.description_zh: 阿里云数字证书管理服务支持上传已有的CSR，以便申请证书时使用，同时也可对上传的CSR进行统一管理

UploadPCACert.description_en: Uploads a PCA certificate to a certificate repository
UploadPCACert.description_zh: 本接口一般用于在证书仓库中上传PCA证书

UploadUserCertificate.description_en: Uploads a certificate, including a standard Chinese national cryptographic (China SM) certificate or a non-China SM certificate
UploadUserCertificate.description_zh: 本接口一般用于上传证书，包括标准国密证书或非国密证书

Verify.description_en: Verifies a data signature by using a private certificate in a certificate application repository
Verify.description_zh: 本接口一般用于证书仓库中PCA证书的签名校验
